review.name: Border Village
review.reason: For: roadside icon (Big Kangaroo) at the WA border, a classic photo stop. Against: Wikivoyage Nullarbor says Border Village is a roadhouse with little to offer, and I found no counted source naming the Big Kangaroo; it is a business and a short stop.

review.name: Mount Dutton Bay Woolshed Museum
review.reason: For: State Heritage-listed 1875 woolshed with restored stone buildings and museum, listed by the tourism board, $10. Against: private property, tours by phone booking only and vary seasonally, one counted source.

review.name: Nuyts Archipelago Conservation Park
review.reason: For: islands and sea lion/bird tours are a real draw named by the tourism board and Wikipedia confirms the park. Against: boat-only, reached via operators, Franklin Islands prohibited, one counted source.

review.name: Ceduna Museum
review.reason: For: two counted sources list the National Trust museum. Against: very limited opening hours (10am to noon), small local museum.

review.name: Ceduna Aboriginal Arts and Culture Centre
review.reason: For: Wikivoyage lists Tjutjuna/Arts Ceduna Aboriginal art display. Against: single source, link dead, mostly a gallery shop and listing may be stale.

review.name: OTC Satellite Earth Station
review.reason: For: tourism board names the 1969 satellite earth station, a distinctive history stop 34 km from Ceduna. Against: unmanned, perimeter-fence view only, one counted source.

review.name: Tumby Bay National Trust Museum
review.reason: For: Wikivoyage See lists the National Trust museum. Against: small branch museum, one source, unclear hours.

review.name: Cowell Agriculture Museum
review.reason: For: tourism board lists the agriculture museum. Against: small local museum, single source, no detail on opening.

review.name: Elvis Presley Museum Whyalla
review.reason: For: SATC lists a 50-year private Elvis collection filling a home, a quirky stop, free. Against: a private home visited by phone booking with the owner, one source, may not be there on arrival.

review.name: Eyre Peninsula Railway
review.reason: For: SATC lists the Port Lincoln Railway Museum in the heritage station, from $6. Against: open Wednesday afternoons only (about 3 h a week), one source, not there whenever a visitor arrives; the name 'Eyre Peninsula Railway' is a line, not a place.

review.name: Nautilus Arts Centre
review.reason: For: SATC lists a 100-year-old foreshore building with two free galleries and a theatre. Against: mainly a performance venue and community arts centre, one source, galleries weekday hours.

existing_fixes.note: Existing WA destination centred 127.0E, span 250 km; the SA Nullarbor places (Head of Bight, Bunda Cliffs, Nullarbor National Park, Eyre Highway) are 290+ km east and are placed standalone. The owner may widen or recentre it instead.

notes: Lock (town) merged into Locks Well Walk (its only source is that walk); Kimba merged into Big Galah; the ten destination towns are destinations, not also spots.
Coffin Bay National Park is a spot of Coffin Bay (only two further kept spots, so not a park destination).
Makybe Diva Statue: wiki null, the 'Makybe Diva' article is the horse (its views are the horse's).
Corrobinnie Hill CP is ~27 km from Wudinna so it is a Wudinna spot, not standalone.

All costs and ticketUrls are null; coordinates are provisional candidate points (park/bay/lake ones are centroids) and every spot is re-pinned with resolve-pin.py. The Fishery Bay, Wittelbee and Kolay Mirica points were dropped.
